thesis.core: Leading specialized tunneling and rail-engineering equipment franchise with state-owned controlling shareholder, but current results do not meet the defensive-stability gate: nine-month earnings fell, operating cash conversion turned negative and receivables/inventory rose. Balance-sheet equity alone is not evidence of distributable owner returns.
thesis.variant_wedge: Q3 revenue recovered 17.67% YoY, but Q3 attributable profit still fell 11.10%; nine-month revenue fell 3.69% and profit fell 25.95%. Backlog and industry position do not resolve collections or cash-flow risks.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: 2026 nine-month deducted profit RMB703.30m / 5.333bn shares annualizes to roughly RMB0.176 per share; FY2025 attributable profit RMB1.483bn (~RMB0.278/share) is a higher-cycle cross-check. Underwrite roughly RMB0.18-0.22 sustainable EPS pending evidence of collections and margin stabilization; use current common BVPS with ROE and cash conversion as valuation discipline, not mechanical trailing PE.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Asset leverage is not extreme, but cash fell from RMB2.38bn to RMB1.68bn, receivables and inventory both increased and nine-month CFO was negative RMB438m. Company attributes cash-flow deterioration to reduced collections and payments of matured supplier payables. Low 9M ROE and negative CFO invalidate a defensive cash-generating label.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Scenario PB multiples are analyst assumptions calibrated conservatively for roughly 4-6% normalized ROE and persistent collection risk; values are sensitivities rather than independent market targets.

catalysts: Two consecutive quarters of sustained positive CFO with receivables growth below revenue growth and reduced overdue collection risk.
Recovery in core equipment orders translates into higher recurring margins and ROE, not just revenue rebound.
Material improvement in project delivery, customer collection and distributable free cash flow.
kill_thesis: Receivables and inventory continue rising while CFO stays negative despite accounting profits.
Normalized ROE remains below cost of equity and pricing/margins continue deteriorating.
Large customer credit impairment, related-party concentration or material deterioration in contract execution emerges.
